opening.text: I've got an itchy rash on my upper body and face that's been bothering me for a year. I've also noticed my eyebrows thinning and losing some of my eyelashes, plus there are lighter patches of skin around my elbows. By the way, I'm a farmer who works on my family's rice farm and takes care of livestock.
